{{Quote|We're not going to hold them off. We're going to push past them, and march to the black heart of our enemy! We fight for our homelands and for our freedom—may the Force be with us!|Satele Shan leads the charge on Rhen Var|<ref name="LostSuns1" />}}
The '''Battle of Rhen Var''' was a conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], fought in the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the war before its end in [[3653 BBY]]. The engagement was catalyzed by the Empire's invasion and seizure of the [[Water/Legends|icy]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]]—an operation overseen by the [[Dark Council]] member and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], [[Darth Mekhis]]. Mekhis, a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] and [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemist]], intended to use the world to test her new creations, and though she was initially successful in her endeavors, a Republic intervention force led by members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] arrived on the planet to challenge the Empire for control.

Commanded by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Satele Shan]], the Republic defense group engaged the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] on Rhen Var and [[Ground warfare/Legends|carved a path]] toward [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Mekhis's [[Darth Mekhis' fortress|command center]]. Although the ranks of the [[Republic Army]] suffered enormous [[Death/Legends|losses]] in the battle, Shan and fellow Knights [[Syo Bakarn]], [[Jaric Kaedan]], and [[Bela Kiwiiks]] rallied their forces and continued their advance. After an extensive skirmish in the frosted [[Tree/Legends|forests]] of Rhen Var, Shan herself stormed Mekhis's compound and engaged the Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]], grievously wounding the Sith during their [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] and claiming victory for the Republic. The Republic's losses during the battle were immense, but the triumph on Rhen Var halted the Empire's advance and briefly turned the tide of the Great Galactic War.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The Emperor and his Dark Council had overreached. They began to strip worlds ''bare'' for energy, materials, ''slaves''. They no longer conquered for the lust of conquest alone—they needed ever-greater resources to maintain what they had.|Jedi Master Ngani Zho|<ref name="LostSuns2" />}}
The Battle of [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]] occurred between [[3660 BBY]] and [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> in the final quarter of the twenty-eight-year [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The war swept across [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] and saw numerous defeats for the ancient democracy as it attempted to slow the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] advance.<ref name="LostSuns2" /> After significant [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] losses on battlefields including [[Battle of Korriban|Korriban]],<ref name="Timeline6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref> the [[Minos Cluster Campaign|Minos Cluster]],<ref name="JoMGD">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref> and [[Invasion of Begeren|Begeren]],<ref name="BotE1">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith]]''</ref> the Republic appeared to be heading toward total annihilation.<ref name="LostSuns2" /> However, after an improbable victory in the [[Battle of Bothawui (Second; Great Galactic War)|second battle]] at [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], the defenders of the Republic and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] rallied to achieve a string of victories that halted the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] advance.<ref name="Timeline5">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui|int=Timeline 5: The Battle of Bothawui}}</ref>

Meanwhile, the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and his [[Dark Council]] grew increasingly desperate for a swift end to the war which had already dragged on for over a [[Time/Legends|decade]].<ref name="LostSuns2" /> Around [[3667 BBY]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> the Empire began an aggressive push toward the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] that included an [[Battle of Alderaan|invasion]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and the [[Blockade of the Hydian Way|blockade]] of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]], all while continuing the Outer Rim onslaught.<ref name="JoMGD" /> Imperial efforts in the Core were met with great resistance, draining the Sith war chest and straining the Empire's military. Regardless, the Empire continued with its strategy and worked to bolster their stretched forces by capturing additional worlds in the Outer Rim to reap much-needed resources and [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="LostSuns2" /> As the war approached its third decade,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Darth Mekhis]], a member of the Dark Council and a practiced Sith [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] and [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemist]], set her sights on Rhen Var<ref name="LostSuns1" /> in the [[Thanium sector/Legends|Thanium Worlds]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> She hoped to seize the world for the Empire and appropriate its resources for the Sith war machine, while also using it as a testing ground for her newly developed weapons.<ref name="LostSuns1" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|These worlds, lush like fruit. Crushed in our hands, juice bleeding down our wrists—this is the Empire as it should be. We shall bring crystalline light to the worlds we lost, and to the Jedi who exiled us. Use my weapons well, Commander.|Darth Mekhis|<ref name="LostSuns1" />}}
[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Mekhis led her invasion force to the world and established her command post in a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] [[Darth Mekhis' fortress|fortress compound]]. While she oversaw the development of new weapons technology in the compound, her division of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] was led in the field by a [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Rhen Var)|troop commander]]<ref name="LostSuns1" /> and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Rymar Quinn]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and was assigned to secure the planet for Mekhis's usage. Composed of [[Sith war droid Mark I|assault droids]], [[Imperial soldier]]s, and [[Sith Warrior]]s, the invasion force was initially highly successful and managed to secure much of the planet's frozen landscape for their master's usage.<ref name="LostSuns1" />

[[File:Battle_of_Rhen_Var.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Republic and Empire clash on Rhen Var's snowy terrain.]]
This dominance was challenged, however, by the arrival of the [[Republic Army|Republic's army]] under the leadership of four [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]]—[[Syo Bakarn]], [[Bela Kiwiiks]], [[Jaric Kaedan]], and [[Satele Shan]], all of whom were former [[Padawan/Legends|apprentices]] of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ngani Zho]]. Shan led the Republic defenders in traversing the [[Water/Legends|snowy]] landscape and [[Ground warfare/Legends|engaging]] Sith forces. The Republic's [[Forty-fifth Battalion]], marching alongside their [[Manka-class armored transport|''Manka''-class armored transports]], served as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] force for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the main [[Army/Legends|army]]. Bakarn, an experienced [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healer]], worked to [[Force healing/Legends|mend the wounds]] incurred by [[Republic soldier]]s, while Kiwiiks served as a tactical expert. Kaedan and Shan, both prodigal combatants, fought on the front lines against the forces of the Empire.<ref name="LostSuns1" />

While the Forty-fifth [[Battalion/Legends|Battalion]] was on a scouting mission in the [[Tree/Legends|forests]] of Rhen Var, the Empire attacked by dispersing weaponized [[Poison/Legends|poison]] gas. All of the scouts were [[Death/Legends|killed]] or incapacitated before the Jedi and Republic reinforcements could reach them. While Bakarn attempted to ease the suffering of the dying scout [[Maxin Davers]], Kiwiiks and Kaedan discussed the impending Imperial onslaught and whether or not they would be able to hold their position. Shan, having overheard their conversation, interjected to proclaim they would not only hold the position, but also push forward to gain ground and advance toward Darth Mekhis's fortress. In the ensuing clash between the Republic forces and the Empire's [[Legion/Legends|legions]], the Jedi and their [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] fought with numerous Imperial [[Troop/Legends|troops]] and Sith. Together, the four Jedi defeated their opponents and led their forces onward.<ref name="LostSuns1" />

As the Republic forces began their siege of Darth Mekhis's stronghold, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] received a communiqué from her [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the field stating that a five-[[Standard minute/Legends|minute]] battlefield projection placed Imperial casualties at 600, but that Rhen Var remained in their control. Upon hearing the news, Mekhis activated her experimental [[chaosphere]] and [[necroswarm colony]] weapons and instructed the commander to use them to destroy their enemies. Although the battle appeared to be won for the Sith, Shan breached the compound and cut down all of Mekhis's defenders before reaching the Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord's]] command center. Upon [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force wave|blasting]] through the [[Blast door/Legends|barrier doors]], Shan confronted and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|engaged]] Darth Mekhis in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]]. Shan ultimately prevailed, wounding Mekhis in the process and claiming victory for the Republic on Rhen Var.<ref name="LostSuns1" /> The [[Bane Brigade]], an Imperial unit infamous for war crimes in the eyes of the Republic, was present at the Battle of Rhen Var and were largely defeated, though some members survived.<ref name="Revenge" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|The Sith would have consumed the galaxy to fuel their ''death machine'', had we not ''stopped'' them at Alderaan and Rhen Var. The memorial droids took three days to recite the names of the fallen—but the enemy's ''expansion'' had been halted.|Ngani Zho|<ref name="LostSuns2" />}}
[[File:Rhen_Var_losses.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Republic suffered heavy losses on Rhen Var.]]
The Battle of Rhen Var proved to be one of the major engagements of the war and a turning point for the Republic. The success of the Rhen Var defense, like the earlier victory on Alderaan, caused morale to soar, and the Jedi and the Republic Military were able to beat back the Sith's forward push enough to obstruct the Empire's advance. However, victory on the icy world came at a high cost—it took three full [[Standard day/Legends|days]] for [[memorial droid]]s to recite all the names of the Republic casualties. Additionally, the failure of the Sith invasion forces only made the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] and his Dark Council even more desperate to end the war, which drove them to develop the battle plans for their ultimate offensive: the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].<ref name="LostSuns2" /> The resultant [[Treaty of Coruscant]] ended the war, but placed the Empire as the conflict's clear winner.<ref name="JoMGD" />

Although Imperial Colonel Rymar Quinn was killed during the conflict,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Darth Mekhis survived the battle and continued to serve on the Dark Council for many years.<ref name="LostSuns1" /> She was a key figure in the crafting of the Treaty of Coruscant,<ref name="LostSuns2" /> but maintained an intense hatred for the Jedi—particularly the opponent who had bested her on Rhen Var, Satele Shan.<ref name="LostSuns1" /> Shan, Bakarn, Kiwiiks, and Kaedan all continued their prolific careers as Jedi and were eventually elevated to the position of Jedi Master. By the later years of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], all four Jedi were serving on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and were recognized as heroes of the Great Galactic War.<ref name="ShanCodex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Satele Shan}}</ref><ref name="BakarnCodex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Syo Bakarn}}</ref><ref name="KaedanCodex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jaric Kaedan}}</ref><ref name="KiwiiksCodex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Bela Kiwiiks}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Rhen Var first appeared in [[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 1|''The Old Republic—The Lost Suns'' 1]],<ref name="LostSuns1" /> the first issue in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic — The Lost Suns|''Star Wars: The Old Republic—The Lost Suns''comic]] series written by [[Alexander Freed]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[June 8]], [[2011]].<ref name="Pub">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/lost_suns_preview/index.html|text=''The Old Republic: The Lost Suns'' Preview}}</ref>
